fact: WHO's Togo annual report for 2024 says Togo uses DHIS2 to collect health data in all districts and that SNIS completeness rates remain unstable: 91% in 2017, a peak of 96.5% in 2018, then 89.2% in 2021.
title: Rapport annuel OMS Togo 2024
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau du Togo
